items.title: Dianne Reeves interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, October 13, 2001
items.q: We started working together when we were about 19 years old... I asked him would he do the arrangements... I remember when I had a band with Billy Childs

ctx.x: Impeccable arrangements. Really creative. You know people are always talking about trying to make the strings swing? Well someone did there.

Billy Childs. I’ve known Billy for a long time. We started working together when we were about 19 years old and our relationship is very, very rich and musically we shared a lot of music together. So when this project came about I asked him would he do the arrangements and he’s like yeah. So we would get together and have cappuccino and talk about the songs. Because it wasn’t so much that I wanted to select the songs —she sang so many songs. Sarah sang so many songs. I wanted to really celebrate her artistry, her…
I’m curious, some of the really hip substitutions that were used on like “Lullaby of Birdland” and stuff, did you two sit down and maybe he would try things and say do you like this?
